BEI THERE BY ORDAINED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY OF
CHEYENNE WYOMING:
Section1.That a new Section9.01.010, Definitions of Chapter9.01, Title9, Public Peace
and Welfare, of the code ofthe City of Cheyenneis hereby created asset out in this ordinance.
A. Purpose. The purpose of this title is to set out definitions for misdemeanor
offenses within the city.This title does not supersede any Wyoming statute.The city is
authorized to prosecute violations of city ordinance and Wyoming statutes, pursuant to Wyo.Stat.
$ 5-6-101 and Wyo. Stat. s 15-1-103(a)(xli).
B.
Definitions.The terms defined in Title 9 Public Peace and Welfare shall be as
follows:
1.
“Assault”' shall be defined and interpreted consistent with Wyo. Stat.  6-2-
501(a).
2.
"Batter”or“Battery” shall be defined and interpreted consistent with Wyo.
Stat.$6-2-501(b).
Section 2.
That this ordinance shall be in full force and effect upon passage and
publication.
